property_summary: For any non-zero account and any token id, balanceOf(account,id) returns the stored balance and never reverts; the mutant removes the zero-address check causing behavior change only for account == address(0) (the reference always reverts for zero address, mutant returns a value) — thus for all inputs the reference either returns a balance for non-zero accounts or reverts for zero address, whereas the mutant will succeed for zero address, violating the rule that balanceOf(address(0), id) must revert.
change_summary: Change the require that forbids zero address to instead allow zero address by removing the require and returning balances[address(0)][id] (i.e., delete the require check), so balanceOf(address(0), id) no longer reverts and returns stored value.
